name: apoint-ms-sql
description: SQL Server for Claude: inspect schemas, query data and manage connections from a form in the chat.
long_description: APoint-ms-sql connects Claude to Microsoft SQL Server. Ask Claude to "manage connections" to add, edit, test and remove connections in a form inside the chat; they apply without a restart. Passwords are stored encrypted for your Windows account (DPAPI) and Claude never sees them. Connections are read-only by default. Includes schema introspection, read-only queries, optional writes on read-write connections, and the AI Insights layer (cached object summaries).

insights.title: AI Insights layer
insights.description: Cache object summaries in the AIInsights schema of each database (install it per database with install_insights_layer). Turn off to never read or write AIInsights.

toon_rows.title: Compact row results (TOON)
toon_rows.description: Return query and list results to Claude as TOON, which uses fewer tokens than JSON. Turn off to get JSON by default (Claude can still ask for TOON per call).

require_apps_capability.title: Connection manager: require MCP Apps support
require_apps_capability.description: Only let the connection manager form's own tools run for hosts that announce MCP Apps support, so a model can never call them directly. Turn off only if the connection manager opens but its buttons fail (see the server log).
